name: Moscow Russian
notes: Moscow Russian — the Central Russian regional variety the standard was codified from, NOT the standard itself (that is `ru`, which this spec pulls every table from). Аканье and plosive [ɡ], shared with `ru` and inherited rather than restated. The genitive desinence ⟨-ого/-его⟩ = [v] is opted into from `ru` via `word_exceptions_base` and `grammatical_endings_base`; without that opt-in this spec emitted его = [ˈjeɡə], a spelling pronunciation no Russian variety has. The features that would make this file more than an alias of `ru` are the старомосковская норма items the modern codification dropped (⟨-чн-⟩ = [ʂn], soft reflexive ⟨-сь⟩, ⟨-кий⟩ = [-kəj], long soft [ʑː]). They are deliberately NOT encoded here: no source for them was consulted for this spec, and guessing a prestige norm's inventory is worse than an honest alias. NEEDS SOURCING before this file earns a quality above stub.
